Halan Hollwood is the husband of Nynelle Stenworth. The latest relevant move: in Chapter 36, "Halan Hollwood rode out of Coldcombe; by the next market day he was living in Gulton," and Nynelle Stenworth went along to live in Gulton as well. No later chapter moves him elsewhere.

Answer: Gulton

Rira Stenworth married Red Jovus and lived in Harrowgate (Ch. 7). In Chapter 34 she packed a single trunk and moved from Harrowgate to Yarlton. No later information places her elsewhere.

Answer: Yarlton

Tassa Brackwood's movements: she was born in the Fenmere family home. In Chapter 13 she married Colan Lindson and lived in Bryngate. In Chapter 22 she left Bryngate and settled in Yarlton. Later mentions (Chapter 39: "Tassa talked for weeks of going to Mirecombe, yet in the end stayed where she was") do not change her residence, so she stays in Yarlton.

Answer: Yarlton

Nynelle Hollmere moved to Miremere for work in Chapter 14 and did not return to Salwick. In Chapter 23 she married Elnar Brackwood at Fenmere, and the couple lived in Fenmere from then on. In Chapter 33 their son Nydan Brackwood was born, and the family lived in Fenmere. This is the latest information about her.

Answer: Fenmere

Thidrek Corrett lived in Mirecombe with Jolia Hollett, then moved from Dunwick to Fenmere (Chapter 23), and Jolia followed him there. The drowning rumor in Chapter 32 is gossip, and the Epilogue shows him alive and well at the summer fair in Fenmere. No later move is recorded.

Answer: Fenmere

Daena Wexwood's moves: Quenwick → Staveton (ch. 25) → Dunholt (ch. 35) → Miremere (ch. 37). In ch. 39 she married Zanar Hollwood at Miremere, and the couple lived in Miremere from then on. Nothing later in the record changes this.

Answer: Miremere

Colan Lindson began in Bryngate and married Tassa Brackwood there. In Chapter 22 he "followed her to Yarlton within the month", and no later passage moves him again, so Yarlton is his latest known home. The text does not say who "her" is, so I am inferring that this is a move to Yarlton rather than a visit.

Answer: Yarlton

Madan Brackwood last appears as moving to Salmere. In Chapter 27 he "followed her to Salmere within the month", and no later paragraph moves him again. The Chapter 22 report that he drowned is only a rumor. He is still active in Chapter 35, so he did not die.

Answer: Salmere

The latest statement about where Cobin Corrett lives is in Chapter 6. His wife left Quenwick for Yarlton, and he followed her there within the month. Chapter 39 shows him still active but gives no new move for him, so Yarlton stands.

Answer: Yarlton

Nyrine Wexwood married Daric Brackwood at Mirecombe in Chapter 25, and the couple lived in Mirecombe from then on. Later paragraphs show her in Mirecombe, such as "In the hill farms of Mirecombe" in Chapter 26 and a conversation with Daric Brackwood in Chapter 27. No later record shows her moving.

Answer: Mirecombe

Jovus Brackwood ("Red Jovus") moved to Harrowgate in Chapter 6 and married Rira Stenworth there. In Chapter 34, "Red Jovus followed her to Yarlton within the month." That is the latest move recorded for him, and nothing later changes it.

Answer: Yarlton

Cotho Hollwood left Wilhaven for Coldcombe in Chapter 2. In Chapter 33 he married Gamira Brackwood at Coldcombe, and "the couple lived in Coldcombe from then on." Nothing later moves him. The Chapter 40 secret-wedding item is only gossip.

Answer: Coldcombe

Eldette Corrett married Halan Hollett at Dunholt (Chapter 31), and the couple lived in Dunholt from then on. Chapter 37 has their son Jozek born with the family living in Dunholt. No later paragraph moves her.

Answer: Dunholt

Aessa Hollwood left Wilhaven and settled in Salford (Chapter 13). In Chapter 26 she married Ellan Lindner in the chapel at Salford, and the couple lived in Salford from then on. Later mentions (Chapter 32, Chapter 40) show no further move.

Answer: Salford

Nynelle Stenworth (the wife of Halan Hollwood) moved from Gulton to Coldcombe in Chapter 18 and did not return. Chapters 22 and 24 still place her family in Coldcombe. Islan Lindner died at Staveton in Chapter 26. She only went back to Gulton in Chapter 36, long after his death, so at the time he died she was in Coldcombe.

Answer: Coldcombe

Mazek died in Chapter 10 (the autumn coughing sickness). Before that, in Chapter 2, Cotho quit Wilhaven and took lodgings in Coldcombe. Between Chapter 2 and Chapter 10, no other move for Cotho appears (Chapter 9 has him talking with the Stenworths, with no relocation mentioned). Thiena followed "him" to Salford in Chapter 9 ¶2493, but it is unclear who "him" is — it could be Ridan Corrett, her husband, who lived in Quenwick and later had a family in Salford. There is no explicit statement that Cotho moved to Salford, so the latest explicit information is Coldcombe.

Answer: Coldcombe

Islis Lindson is first recorded in the Lindson household of the market town of Bryngate, and nothing before Chapter 5 says she moved. Senelle Brackwood died in Chapter 5, so Islis was still in Bryngate then. Her own death, in Chapter 9, is recorded with burial at Bryngate, which fits.

Answer: Bryngate

Brevie Hollmere died in Chapter 9. Thidrek Corrett was married to Jolia Hollett and lived in Mirecombe (Chapters 1 and 3). He did not leave until Chapter 18, when Jolia's husband rode out of Mirecombe for Dunwick. So at the time of Brevie's death he was still in Mirecombe.

Answer: Mirecombe

Eldette Corrett is placed in the river crossing at Quenwick, where the Corrett household lived. Her mother Ilrine and then her father Cobin moved to Yarlton before Nyvie Hollett died in chapter 6, but the record never says Eldette went with them. Her later scenes with the Wexwoods, who live in Quenwick, also fit her staying there. Her location at the time of Nyvie's death is therefore Quenwick, the latest information available.

Answer: Quenwick

Seena Hollett was a daughter of the Hollett household in Mirecombe, and the record shows no move for her. Orrine Stenworth died in Chapter 22 (¶4167), and a scene a few paragraphs later (¶4175) places Seena Hollett in the hill farms of Mirecombe.

Answer: Mirecombe

Cotho Hollwood left Wilhaven for good after a quarrel in Chapter 2 and took lodgings in Coldcombe. No move by him is recorded between then and Seena Orlwood's death by drowning in Chapter 11. The moves of Cotho Brackwood, a different person, don't apply. Later, in Chapter 33, he marries and settles in Coldcombe.

Answer: Coldcombe

Islis Lindson was the wife of Colan Lindson. The record says the coughing sickness took her in Chapter 9, and she was buried at Bryngate. Rira Stenworth married Red Jovus at Harrowgate in Chapter 7, and the couple lived in Harrowgate from then on. She did not leave Harrowgate for Yarlton until Chapter 34, long after Islis died.

Answer: Harrowgate

Conar Hollett's household was in the hill farms of Mirecombe from the start (Chapter 1). Nothing in the record shows him moving away before Ridan Corrett died at Gulton in Chapter 20. Later chapters still place him in Mirecombe, for example the Chapter 26 scene set in the hill farms of Mirecombe.

Answer: Mirecombe

Ilzek Wexwood died in Chapter 29 (buried at Staveton). Orvie Hollett married Rozek Hollwood in Chapter 16 and lived in Mirecombe from then on. Later chapters (22, 28) say her family lived in Mirecombe. The Chapter 22 parcel to Halan with the jade ring does not show that she moved. No later move is recorded for her.

Answer: Mirecombe

Dadette Lindner died in Chapter 15. Nynelle Stenworth lived in Gulton at that point: she was there in Chapter 10, and again in Chapter 16 when her son Zanar was born ("The family lived in Gulton"). She only moved to Coldcombe in Chapter 18.

Answer: Gulton

Orbin Stenworth's original wife was Orrine Stenworth, who died at Coldcombe in Chapter 22. In Chapter 26 he married Nylis Corrett at Mirecombe. Later chapters show them as a family in Staveton: Nylis gave birth to Garald Stenworth, and a daughter, Rolde, was born to them. No later passage mentions her death or a separation.

Answer: Nylis Corrett

Thiena Hollwood first married Ridan Corrett, then in Chapter 21 married Maric Lindson. Later they have a daughter, Elnelle Lindson (Chapter 33), and Maric is still present in Chapter 38. There is no record of Maric's death or any later marriage.

Answer: Maric Lindson

Lutho Hollmere's wife was Brevie Hollmere, who died in Chapter 9 ("old age, quietly in sleep took Brevie Hollmere"). In Chapter 38, "Thivie Brackwood took Lutho in marriage at Dunholt," and the couple lived in Dunholt from then on. This is the latest marital information about Lutho, and no later chapter changes it.

Answer: Thivie Brackwood

Conar Hollett's wife was Nyvie Hollett. Chapter 6 records that a long wasting sickness took Nyvie that autumn and that she was buried at Mirecombe. Nothing in the record shows Conar marrying again. The rumor that he drowned in Chapter 38 is contradicted by the Epilogue, which has him alive and well. So he is alive, but his wife has died and he has no living spouse.

Answer: none

Aessa Hollwood was married to Mazek Hollwood at the start of the record (Chapter 1). In Chapter 26 she married Ellan Lindner in the chapel at Salford, and they lived in Salford from then on. Chapter 32 still shows Ellan with her. No later chapter mentions Ellan's death or any other change to the marriage.

Answer: Ellan Lindner

Maric Lindson was first married to Seena Orlwood (Chapter 1). In Chapter 21 he married Thiena Hollwood at Gulton. In Chapter 33 a daughter, Elnelle Lindson, was born to Thiena Hollwood and Maric, and the family lived in Coldcombe. Later passages show Maric and Thiena still together, and nothing records her death or a separation.

Answer: Thiena Hollwood

Colan Lindson's first wife was Islis Lindson. In Chapter 9, "the coughing sickness took the wife of Colan Lindson; she was buried at Bryngate." In Chapter 13, Colan Lindson and Tassa Brackwood were wed at Bryngate. In Chapter 16, Tassa gave birth to their daughter Rorine. No later passage reports Tassa's death or any other change.

Answer: Tassa Brackwood

Elnar Brackwood was married to Senelle Brackwood at the start. Senelle died in Chapter 5, after a fall from the mill loft. In Chapter 23, Elnar married Nynelle Hollmere at Fenmere, and they lived there. They later had a son, Nydan Brackwood, in Chapter 33. Nothing in the record says Nynelle died or that the marriage ended.

Answer: Nynelle Hollmere

Nynelle Stenworth and Halan Hollwood were husband and wife (Chapter 1), and they went on having children together, the latest being Ilrald Hollwood in Chapter 22. Chapter 38 still refers to "the husband of Nynelle Stenworth", so the marriage continues. The Chapter 34 claim that she drowned is only something Ortho told people at the inn, so it is a rumor, not a fact. No record shows Halan dying or the marriage ending.

Answer: Halan Hollwood

Halan Hollwood is married to Nynelle Stenworth (Chapter 1, ¶279). Later chapters keep showing them together as a family, with children born in Gulton and then Coldcombe, and "the wife of Halan Hollwood" appears in Chapters 18 and 29. Nothing in the record says she died or that they separated.

Answer: Nynelle Stenworth

Ellan Lindner married Aessa Hollwood in the chapel at Salford (Chapter 26). Nothing later records her death or a separation. In Chapter 32, Aessa and Ellan are still talking together.

Answer: Aessa Hollwood

Rorine Lindson's marriage appears in Chapter 38: "Before the autumn was out, Ilrald Hollwood took Rorine Lindson in marriage at Coldcombe. The couple lived in Coldcombe from then on."

Nothing later in the record shows Ilrald Hollwood dying or the marriage ending. In Chapter 40, Rorine is still finishing her promise to teach the children of Coldcombe.

Answer: Ilrald Hollwood

Rira Stenworth married Red Jovus (Jovus Brackwood) at Harrowgate in Chapter 7. In Chapter 30 they have a daughter, Neena Brackwood. In Chapter 34 Rira moved from Harrowgate to Yarlton, but nothing says the marriage ended or that Jovus died. Chapter 21 mentions "the husband of Rira Stenworth," which fits a living husband. The latest information therefore still has her married to Jovus Brackwood.

Answer: Jovus Brackwood

Rozek Hollwood married Orvie Hollett at Mirecombe in Chapter 16. Later chapters show them still together, with children Hamira (Chapter 22) and Rimira (Chapter 28), and with Orvie remarking on the river in Chapter 27. Nothing in the record says Orvie died or that the marriage ended.

Answer: Orvie Hollett

Ortho Corrett married Movie Lindson in the chapel at Bryngate (Chapter 29), and they had a son, Karic Corrett (Chapter 36). Nothing in the record says she died or that they separated, so the marriage still stands at the end.

Answer: Movie Lindson

Orvie Hollett married Rozek Hollwood at Mirecombe in Chapter 16, and they went on to have daughters Hamira and Rimira. Nothing later says Rozek died or that they separated. The only other marriage item is gossip in Chapter 40, which claims Cotho Hollwood and Jolia Hollett wed in secret. That concerns Jolia, not Orvie, and it is a rumor.

Answer: Rozek Hollwood

Chapter 38 says "Before the autumn was out, Thivie Brackwood took Lutho in marriage at Dunholt. The couple lived in Dunholt from then on." This is the only marriage record for Thivie, and nothing later mentions Lutho's death or a separation.

Answer: Lutho

Cobin Corrett was married to Ilrine Corrett (Chapter 1). The wife left Quenwick for Yarlton and Cobin followed her (Chapter 6). Later passages (Chapter 8, Chapter 39) show Cobin and Ilrine still together, and nothing records a death or a separation. Cobin's later apprenticeship as a scribe changes his trade, not his marriage.

Answer: Ilrine Corrett

Chapter 25 states that Daric Brackwood took Nyrine in marriage at Mirecombe, and the couple lived there from then on. Later mentions (Chapter 27) show Nyrine alongside Daric Brackwood. No later record shows his death or a divorce.

Answer: Daric Brackwood

Chapter 26 states "Islan died of the coughing sickness at Staveton." Islan Lindner's belongings were then distributed, with the glass comb handed to Wevie Lindner. No later passage shows Islan alive again.

Answer: no

Chapter 11 states that Seena Orlwood died of drowning in the flood at Mirecombe. Later entries that mention "Seena" refer to Seena Hollett, who is a different person, or to an unspecified Seena. Nothing in the record says Seena Orlwood came back to life.

Answer: no

In Chapter 26 (¶4648), the record says old age quietly took Isbin Hollwood in his sleep that autumn, and he was buried at Gulton. Chapters 28 to 40 give no sign that this changed. The only later mentions of an "Isbin" are earlier-chapter events or unrelated.

Answer: no

Chapter 35 says Wevie Lindner died quietly in her sleep that winter and was buried at Salmere. Nothing later in the record contradicts this. Chapter 26 has her receiving the glass comb and having a son, and Chapter 27 has her moving to Salmere, but all of that comes before her death in Chapter 35.

Answer: no

Chapter 15 records that Dadette Lindner died of a fall from the mill loft at Staveton. Later passages show only other people's activities, and nothing contradicts her death.

Answer: no

Chapter 5 records that a fall from the mill loft took Senelle Brackwood, and she was buried at Fenmere. Nothing later says she returned to life. A later line, "Madan Brackwood followed her to Salmere within the month," does not contradict this. Senelle is therefore dead at the end of the record.

Answer: no

In Chapter 9, the record says "That summer, old age, quietly in sleep took Brevie Hollmere; she was buried at Salwick." This is her death, and nothing later reverses it. Later entries that mention her, such as the one about the only son of Brevie Hollmere in Chapter 32, refer to her as a parent and do not show her alive.

Answer: no

Chapter 9 says the coughing sickness took the wife of Colan Lindson, who was buried at Bryngate. Islis is Colan's wife, so she died there. Nothing later in the record says otherwise. Colan fathered a child with Tassa in Chapter 16, but that does not change Islis's death.

Answer: no

The record says in Chapter 20 that "Ridan Corrett died of old age, quietly in sleep at Gulton." Nothing later in the record contradicts this, so he is not alive at the end.

Answer: no

In Chapter 10, the record says "That autumn, the coughing sickness took Mazek; he was buried at Wilhaven." Later chapters show nothing that reverses this. Chapter 2 and Chapter 5 mention Mazek while he was still alive, and Chapter 8 does too, but all of those come before his death.

Answer: no

In Chapter 6, a long wasting sickness took Nyvie Hollett that autumn, and she was buried at Mirecombe. Nothing later says she returned or was still alive. Later mentions of her are only as a reference ("the only son of Nyvie Hollett", "eldest daughter of Nyvie Hollett"), which don't change her death.

Answer: no

Chapter 22 states that Orrine Stenworth died of a kick from a cart horse at Coldcombe. Later paragraphs mention Orrine only in the form of "Orrine" in earlier chapters, and nothing after Chapter 22 says she is alive, so the death stands as the latest information.

Answer: no

The record shows no death for Maric Lindson. In Chapter 17, a rumor started by Orrine said he had died of plague, but a rumor is not a fact. The later entries show him alive and active: he lived in Coldcombe with Thiena Hollwood and their daughter Elnelle, moved to Gulton as well, and appeared in dialogue in Chapter 32 and Chapter 38.

Answer: yes

Madan Brackwood is alive. The report of his drowning in Chapter 22 is only a rumor, since no body was ever seen. He appears alive after it: he talks with Seena Hollett in Chapter 22, fathers a son, Lubin, in Chapter 26, follows someone to Salmere in Chapter 27, and counts coins and receives the glass comb in Chapter 35.

Answer: yes

The drowning claim in Chapter 32 is only gossip, told by Aessa Hollwood, with no body ever seen. The Epilogue then states that Thidrek Corrett was seen hale and well at the summer fair in Fenmere, which contradicts the rumor. So he is alive at the end of the record.

Answer: yes

Nynelle Stenworth is alive. The only report of her death is Ortho's claim in Chapter 34 that she drowned, and since no body was ever seen, it is a rumor, not a fact. After that, she is still active in Chapter 35, moves to Gulton in Chapter 36, and in Chapter 38 her husband gives her a pewter comb.

Answer: yes

Daena Wexwood's latest recorded events: in Chapter 34 a rumor said she was dead of plague, but that is only a rumor from a peddler. Later she moved to Dunholt, then to Miremere (Chapter 37), and in Chapter 39 she wed Zanar Hollwood at Miremere. Nothing records her death, so she is alive.

Answer: yes

The record includes a claim in Chapter 38 that Conar Hollett drowned crossing the estuary, but this came from Halan Hollett as a report, with no body ever seen. The Epilogue then says Conar was seen hale and well at the summer fair in Mirecombe, which contradicts the drowning story. The later, direct observation outweighs the earlier rumor.

Answer: yes

Elnar Brackwood appears alive throughout. He married Nynelle Hollmere in Chapter 23 and had a son, Nydan, in Chapter 33. In the same chapter he is still doing ordinary things, such as talking with Nydan and humming while scrubbing the step. No death is recorded for him.

Answer: yes

No death of Halan Hollwood appears in the record. His latest mention (Chapter 36) has him leaving Coldcombe and living in Gulton, and nothing afterward says he died.

Answer: yes

Pebin Wexwood's latest mentions: in Chapter 37 he left Harrowgate and settled in Bryngate. No death is recorded for him anywhere in the material. The only death rumor concerns Daena Wexwood, and it is unconfirmed. Ilzek Wexwood's death is stated outright, but he is a different person. So Pebin is alive as far as the record shows.

Answer: yes

Nynelle Hollmere: moved to Miremere (ch14), later married Elnar Brackwood and lived in Fenmere (ch23), and had a son Nydan Brackwood (ch33). There is no record of her death. The drowning rumor concerns Nynelle Stenworth, a different person.

Answer: yes

No death of Cotho Hollwood is mentioned anywhere in the record. The last relevant mention (Chapter 40) has him sending an iron chalice by carrier, so he is still active at the end.

Answer: yes

The record shows Aera Corrett being born in Chapter 23 and never reports her death. The only death-related item is a claim in Chapter 32 that her father, Thidrek Corrett, drowned, and that concerns him, not her.

Answer: yes

No death of Ellan Lindner is recorded. The latest mentions show him alive: he married Aessa Hollwood in Chapter 26, and he appears in ordinary scenes through Chapter 40 (reading the almanac, talking of going to Quenwick). Other family members' deaths are recorded (Dadette in Chapter 15, Wevie in Chapter 35), but none for Ellan.

Answer: yes

The iron chalice passed through these holders in order:

- Nyrine Wexwood owned it, then gave it to Eldette Corrett.
- Jotho the Younger won it from Eldette Corrett at cards. The later "Jotho Corrett" is presumably the same person.
- Jotho Corrett gave it to Halan Hollwood.
- Halan Hollwood gave it to Cotho Hollwood.
- Cotho Hollwood sent it by carrier to Ortho Corrett, who received it safely. This is the last transfer in the record.

Answer: Ortho Corrett

The latest event involving the pewter chalice is in Chapter 40, where Fetho Hollmere pressed it into the hands of Ulvie Hollwood and would take nothing for it. Before that, in Chapter 25, it had reached Fetho Hollmere by parcel and became his to keep. No later paragraph moves it again.

Answer: Ulvie Hollwood
